image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - First Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: The document is a fact sheet titled 'Consolidated Financial Data - First Quarter, Fiscal 2026' from Infosys, presenting a comprehensive statement of income for three months ending on June 30, 2025, June 30, 2024, and March 31, 2025. It includes financial metrics such as revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, both before and after non-controlling interests. The data is presented in both US dollars and Indian rupees, showing year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter growth percentages. Notable insights include a 4.8% year-over-year growth in revenues and a 5.8% growth in net profit before non-controlling interests for the period ending June 30, 2025. The document also highlights operating margins and earnings per share, providing a detailed financial overview for stakeholders.
